description:
Dublin City University (DCU) is a pioneering public university founded in Ireland in 1980. DCU, Dublin City University is a university among Ireland's schools that provides high quality education within the framework of its economic and social needs. Dublin City University has more than 100 teaching programs in different subjects and fields that it offers to students in undergraduate and graduate education. Dublin City University has 2,000 international students from 114 countries in 2018. Dublin City University's undergraduate and postgraduate courses cater to students from across Ireland as well as a large number of international students.

The school offers the latest technology and services to equip undergraduate students with the skills and abilities to become leaders in their chosen fields. DCU teaches approximately 12,000 undergraduate and graduate students at its campus in Dublin, Ireland. The future of the university, which is ranked 401 in the Times, is very clear. Dublin City University is among the top 100 universities in the junior university rankings.

Rooms at the Hampstead and College Park Apartments on the Glasnevin campus or Purcell House on the All Hallows campus are allocated for international students.

Hampstead Apartments; It consists of sixty-one comfortable apartments, each with five en-suite bedrooms and a shared living/kitchen/dining area. Each apartment consists of four single ensuite rooms and a double ensuite room for single occupancy. In each bedroom, students have their own study area.

College Park Apartments; It consists of sixty standard apartments, each with either four or five ensuite bedrooms (one double ensuite for single use in each apartment) and a communal living/kitchen/dining area. Both wifi and landline internet access (internet cable) in each bedroom none) and a workspace. Each apartment has a telephone (incoming calls only) in the living area.
